experiment: 2026-10-27 T6: no_gh - the 24-bit global-history input group removed, 57 inputs / 3648 B
arms_note: Input-configuration ablation only: NUM_INPUTS 81 -> 57 and TM_G_HIST_BITS 24 -> 0. Inside tm.cc the global-history write loop is guarded by TM_G_HIST_BITS, so the later groups shift down by 24 and the 57-input contract holds. TM algorithm (tm_predict / tm_update / tm_fb_*) untouched; tm.cc is byte-identical to the baseline (d13a27d3...). TM_INPUT_NAMES lives inside #ifdef DUMP_STATE_CSV, which is off, so it does not need editing for this build.
